### Cascading Failures

**`Api.csproj`** — depends on `Services.csproj` but had **no errors of its own**. It failed only because its dependency (`Services`) failed to compile.

### Fix

Add the `Newtonsoft.Json` NuGet package to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

Or run:
```bash
dotnet add Services/Services.csproj package Newtonsoft.Json
```
